productionFindings.title: Execution IR rejected dynamic ASOF right-source shapes
productionFindings.trigger: After fixture calibration, the dynamic ASOF cases and the original-versus-substitute comparisons failed while typed ASOF cases remained available; the underlying boundary was MQ9001 with NotSupportedException stating that ASOF lowering required a non-dynamic source entity or table-row right source.
productionFindings.rootCause: BuildAsOfJoinTable treated ExpandoAdapterShape as unsupported even though the coupled TABLE/COUPLE contract permits ASOF joins. The execution path had no generated-row candidate list for the dynamic right source, so index creation and probing could not preserve the dynamic adapter shape.
productionFindings.repair: ASOF lowering now materializes an ExpandoAdapter right source into a generated-row candidate list before creating the ASOF index, carries the generated row type through the execution variable and accepts the prepared source. The helper was split into a dedicated partial file to remain within the round-13 production hotspot budget.

obligations.REC-132-O01: The permanent matrix executes typed and dynamic coupled ASOF forms separately, including inner, left, partitioned, tie-break, reverse-inequality and CTE-backed source shapes; the COUPLE-039 and ASOF adjacencies preserve the surrounding contracts.
obligations.REC-132-O02: The metadata family verifies modifiers and logical types through source planning, materialization, generated execution and output metadata, including nullable decimal carrier behavior.
obligations.REC-132-O03: The provider-compatibility family expects MQ3071 at Bind with SourceContractError envelopes and non-typo explanations; the Release gate and IR adjacency preserve the execution boundary.
obligations.REC-132-O04: The original-versus-substitute family compares matching typed and dynamic results, and the resolved finding closes only the dynamic ASOF caveat represented by the frozen fixture rather than by a typed replacement.
obligations.acceptance: All 48 frozen cases pass, the dynamic source path is exercised through the real compiler and generated execution, unsupported provider contracts remain explicit, and the production repair is limited to the identified ASOF lowering boundary.
